admissionPolicy.sourceOwner: Accountable owner must review exact claim applicability, source version/rights and positive/negative/UNKNOWN. Authored graph owner field alone is not signature.
admissionPolicy.independentOracle: New independent source-first domain-review context evaluates semantic meaning and falsifiers, not merely self-defined fixtures; same personal GitHub account is permitted, but writing the packet is not Oracle.
admissionPolicy.externalSource: External URL is NOT immutable published source bytes or exact revision; bind publication metadata, applicable target Windows build and separately adjudicate before PASS.
admissionPolicy.nativeHost: A native test/Host receipt and actual OS applicability must be separately pinned if the obligation requires it; pure V8 and authored fixtures do not count.
admissionPolicy.globalAndRoot: Every applicable Global invariant and Root postcondition is evaluated separately; passing children cannot sign Root/Global SAP.
admissionPolicy.production: SAP/Owner/Oracle/DIE8 B5/Product/L2/DIS/AOT/Runtime remain mutually separate gates; no mutations or release from this packet.
